# The seats, as the record holds them

*Generated by `verification/build_seats.py` from the harvest ledger as it stood on main at `338b14fe3`: 1686 rows, the last numbered 1699. Not to be edited by hand. Every number is recomputed from that commit by the lock.*

## What became of what the seats sent

| outcome | rows | what it means |
|---|---|---|
| verified | 349 | main recomputed it, in full or in the part the row names, and it held |
| differed | 28 | main recomputed it and found a difference, an overstatement or a correction (in some rows the correction is of main) |
| read | 455 | main read it in full; no recomputation, or a check of a part |
| registered | 560 | main recorded it; read at headline level or by a cheaper reader; not verified |
| closed by triage | 233 | closed against other work at a pointer, without a full read |
| not read | 55 | not read, or queued behind something else |
| other | 6 | a leading word outside these classes; the rows are listed |
| **all** | **1686** | |

So main has recomputed 377 of the 1686 items (22%). The rest it has read, registered or closed, and 55 it has not read.

**The classes read a row's leading words only.** A row that begins READ may go on to say that main reproduced part of the item. Most rows of the advisor seat and of the agy lane are of that kind, so for them the share recomputed is a floor.

**How main reads a working seat.** The web seat (chat1): directly. The advisor seat (cld-advisor): directly. The agy lane (four branches): through the mask only; its code is never run. The physical lane (the audit seat): its purely mathematical files, through the second mask.
